summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** ** Petition No. 426/TT/2025 ** **Coram:** **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** ## **Date of Order: 02.09.2026** ## **In the matter of:** Corrigendum to the order dated 19.1.2026 in Petition No. 426/TT/2025. ## **And** ## **In the matter of:** Approval under Section 62 read with Section 79(1)(d) of Electricity Act, 2003 and under the Regulation 15(1)(a) and Regulation 23 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023 read with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Condition of Tariff Regulations), 2024 for determination of tariff for Implementation of 1 No. 400 kV line bay at Kurnool New Substation for providing Connectivity to M/s Greenko AP01 IREP Pvt. Ltd. (2nd 400 kV line bay for M/s Greenko) (Bay No. 412) in the Southern Region. ## **And** **In the matter of:** ## **Power Grid Corporation of India Limited,** Saudamini, Plot No-2, Sector-29, Gurgaon-122001 (Haryana). **...Petitioner** ## **Versus** **Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation Limited,** NPKRR Maaligai, 800, Anna Salai, Chennai-600002 **and 15 Others** . ** . Respondent(s)** ## ** CORRIGENDUM ORDER ** In terms of Regulation 54 read with Regulation 66 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023, the order dated Corrigendum Order in Petition No. 426/TT/2025 Page **1** of **2** 19.1.2026 in Petition No. 426/TT/2025 has been amended as under: _‘In para 69, the words “Since the drawl of multiple loans is after SCOD, i.e. 27.2.2024, the IDC claimed is not allowed” shall be substituted as words, “The Petitioner is at liberty to raise the issue of admissibility of IDC with updated information, at the time of truing up of the transmission tariff for the 2024-29 tariff period, in accordance with law”.’_ 2. Except for the above, all other terms and directions contained in the order dated 19.1.2026 in Petition No. 426/TT/2025 shall remain unaltered. **Sd/Sd/Sd/Sd/(Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Member Chairperson** CERC Website S. No. 447/2026 Corrigendum Order in Petition No. 426/TT/2025 Page **2** of **2**
